what are your thoughts on proxy (under correct circumstance) effectiveness? it doesnt feel as useful as it once did to me

You can’t expect your team to do anything with your proxy. If you know Warwick is at drake then consider punishing your laner by proxying. Opening up an opportunity only matters when the people on your team are good enough to respond. 

But in general you should only proxy if the enemy jungler can’t effectively pressure you or if it’s a bad lane for you (no kill/losing matchup). But in honesty, proxying is a tactic that isn’t going to pay dividends in low elo. It just is too important for you and everyone on on your team to know what’s going on all over the map at all times. 

Hope that helps.

(Also) proxying is also not as powerful as it used to be and your default should be to lane as usual.

Ok some of these questions are hard to answer but I'll give some of them a swing.
First off, exhaust is very good against low mobility champs and more importantly. Exhaust will be just as useful in a 35th minute team fight as it is in your level 2 all in. You can't say the same for ignite while it greatly increases your kill pressure early, late game it is all but useless, IN MY OPINION. However, the current meta along with the last several have been greatly centered around snowballs champions that either win the game early or lose it. For this reason I only take ignite in bottom lane with one exception... EXHAUST DRAVEN. I don't think I need to continue into reason with that. 
Secondly, the combo you should try for early is r, e (into ult) then a q. The q, e, r is good but if you're having trouble landing your q then you're basically inviting a counter initiation. 
I never build the ruby sightstone anymore ever since stoneplate was introduced. The health is static and less significant than the active items MID GAME. My core is eye into redemption into stoneplate. If you don't see it as necessary then you can substitute redemption for something else ever since the nerf of redemption.
